newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Death toll rises to 88, 172 missing in Malaysia storm.
newsitem.headline: Death toll rises to 88, 172 missing in Malaysia storm.

text.p: Rescue workers have recovered 88 bodies from debris after a rainstorm lashed Malaysia's eastern Sabah state on Christmas day, police said on Thursday. At least 172 people were missing.
They said the death toll was rising by the hour in the Keningau interior of Sabah, on Borneo island.
In the latest update of the death toll, police said 78 bodies were found in the Keningau interior of Sabah, on Borneo island, where widespread flooding was caused by the storm.
Ten other bodies were found elsewhere near Keningau. Police said earlier that 62 bodies had been found.
The national Bernama news agency said about 50 houses were washed away when a river overflowed in Keningau and buildings were damaged around the state capital Kota Kinabalu. Boats offshore were sunk.
Sabah's weather department linked the rains to tropical storm Greg, which was moving in at more than 50 kph (30 mph) towards Sabah and neighbouring Sarawak state.
